description: The Central Electricity Authority (CEA) of India publishes an API page for its data, which lists the datasets the API serves: All India Installed Capacity (renewable energy sources), All India Installed Capacity, Installed Capacity region wise, Installed Capacity state wise, Power Supply Position for energy, Power Supply Position for peak, Transformation Capacity, Transmission Lines, Power Generation, Renewable Energy Installed Capacity Composition and Per Capita Consumption. The page text read shows the dataset names and a file-details panel, not the endpoint syntax, parameters or response formats. Coverage is India nationally, with regional and state breakdowns implied by the region-wise and state-wise datasets. Access: the API page on the CEA site, free; no licence and no update schedule are stated in the text read. Caveats: endpoint details could not be read, so field-level content is unverified. It suits studies of Indian generation capacity, supply position and transmission, and relates to the India Data Portal Ministry of Power datasets catalogued here.
